t: Qetzat debarim haasurim letaltel beyom tob
s: Qetzat debarim haasurim letaltel beyom tob ubo d' seipim: hassuma vehazzaqen en yotzeim bemaqqel lo lirshut harabbim velo lekarmelit, mippene shehu derek chol vezilzul leyom tob, kevan sheepshar lo lehallek belo maqqel zeh veeno notelo ella letaqqen uleyashsher pesiotayv. Veken en haroeh yotze betarmilo lo lirshut harabbim velo lekarmelit, mippene shehu derek chol vezilzul leyom tob.
Haqqittea umi shennikkavvetzu gide shoqayv vehacholeh — dinam beyom tob kemo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a.

Muttar lehotzi adam lirshut harabbim ap al pi shehu yakol lelek beatzmo veeno noseo ella kede shello yidchaquhu bene hashshuq, o kede shello yittannepu begadayv, o bemaqom shehu mabit lelek beatzmo shello yippol, kevan sheyyesh tzorek qetzat behotzaa zo — muttar lehotzio beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman tqy"ch. Abal asur lehotzio al hakkisse, dehaynu shehu yosheb beqattedra ubene adam toanin otah, mippene shehu derek chol vezilzul leyom tob. Veim hu adam sherabbim tzerikim elayv beyom tob lishmoa chokmato, o shehu holek lepaqqeach al isqe rabbim — muttar lehotzio bakkisse apillu al hakkatep (perush shebbene adam nosein hakkisse al ketepam derek parhesya) ubetok appiryon.

En manhigin et habbehema bemaqqel apillu betok maboy hamorab im rabbim metzuyim sham, vaapillu hizmin hammaqqel meereb yom tob veyichado lekak sheen kan issur lo mishshum hotzaa velo mishshum tiltul etzim (ayyen simman tq"b), mikkol maqom asur mippene marit haayin, shennireh kemolikah lemaqom rachoq lemokrah sham shehu tzarik lehanhigah harbeh, ulekak hu manhigah bemaqqel.
